'''''Turning Point''''' is a 2016 ''Star Wars'' fan film directed and edited by [[Brandon Baity]]. It was an entry in the 2016 Star Wars Fan Film Contest. Baity posted the finished short on 17 July 2017 and a teaser trailer on 25 October 2016.<ref name="film">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00lP1TCpIjw Turning Point - A Star Wars Fan Film], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (17 July 2017). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-00lP1TCpIjw Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="teaser">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xFqYok-3lvA Star Wars: Turning Point Teaser Trailer #2], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (25 October 2016). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-xFqYok-3lvA Internet Archive].</ref>

The posted description credits Tom Andersen and Brandon Baity as writers and as directors of photography. Cast: Nic Stevens (Joran), TJ Strickland (Nahru), Anthony Nelson (Morg), and Christie Quinn (Seema). Zachary Weitzel is credited for armor; Indira Nauth as production assistant and audio. Runtime of the posted short is 7 minutes 9 seconds.
